description: Schéma canonique des données Hockey Dynasty. Les notes/potentiels sont des évaluations de jeu et non des statistiques officielles.

organization.name: Official team name
organization.ahlAffiliateId: Stable AHL team ID; null until verified

player.position: C | LW | RW | D | G | null
player.league: NHL | AHL | CHL | NCAA | EUROPE | OTHER

dataRules: Do not invent player records, rights, affiliations, pick ownership, or trade conditions.
Keep source facts separate from game ratings and potential.
Store source and verification date for each record.
Use stable IDs so trades and roster updates do not duplicate players.
Never infer a contract value, term, clause, or expiry status from a cap hit alone.
Keep cap hit, actual season salary, signing bonus, and two-way salary as separate fields.
A contract with unknown data must use null and verificationStatus PARTIAL or UNVERIFIED, never a guessed value.
A player may have one active NHL contract record per season; retained salary obligations are recorded separately from player ownership.

contract.playerId: Stable player ID; must match exactly one player record
contract.organizationId: NHL team code holding the NHL contract/rights
contract.contractType: STANDARD | ENTRY_LEVEL | TWO_WAY | AHL_ONLY | PTO | RFA | UFA | UNKNOWN
contract.capHitUSD: number or null; annual average value charged to NHL cap
contract.baseSalaryUSD: number or null; salary paid in the specified season, distinct from cap hit
contract.clauses: NONE | NTC | M-NTC | NMC | M-NTC-NMC | UNKNOWN
contract.sourceUrl: URL of reliable source for this contract
